messages:
incident-bot: HIGH SEV - GPU pool eu-central-1 saturated. queue_length=1250, p99_latency=11.8s, dropped_requests=42, affected_routes=[/v1/generate,/v1/chat]. paging oncall-sre and ops-lead :rotating_light:
oncall-sre: On it. joining now. what's current autoscaler status?
maya: seeing repeated scaleup attempts failing with 'quotaExceeded' from cloud provider in cluster-autoscaler logs. pasted tail below:
maya: ```
E0422 10:12:03 kubelet.go:123] Failed to attach GPU instance: quotaExceeded: Insufficient quota for request
I0422 10:12:05 cluster-autoscaler.go:507] Scale attempt 8 -> failed: provisioning quotaExceeded
```
ryan-eng: thanks. can someone confirm if Dedicated pools are available for overflow? we can route some traffic there as immediate fallback.
jem: support-bot reported spike in 429s for ~12 customers, mostly mid-tier. support-bot: customers=[acme-inc, bluewave, tinychat], sample errors=429 rate 18% on generate, queue wait > 30s for some requests.
ops-lead: good call. oncall-sre, if we can shift non-sensitive traffic to dedicated-gpu-pool-2, do it. we'll notify affected customers.
oncall-sre: initiating routing rule override: sending request to router-control API now.
oncall-sre: ```
POST /api/v1/routes/override
{"route":"/v1/generate","target_pool":"dedicated-gpu-pool-2","duration_sec":1800}
```
oncall-sre: override accepted, traffic rebalanced ~20% to dedicated pool. queue_length in eu-central dropped to ~980 but still high.
maya: autoscaler still failing to provision new nodes because project quota is at limit for GPU type a100. Cloud support ticket opened (CS-98712). ETA unknown.
ryan-eng: can we spin up a smaller instance type (e.g., v100/rtx) and serve a lower-capacity quantized model temporarily? might relieve the queue.
jem: product OK with fallback to smaller model for non-SLA customers. need to tag traffic so we don't violate commitments for enterprise customers.
ops-lead: agree. oncall-sre, coordinate with runtime-team to deploy a quantized variant and add model-routing rule.
oncall-sre: pinging eng-runtime channel and starting canary deploy for model=redwood-lite-quantized on rtx-pool.
maya: deploying followup: ```
kubectl apply -f deploy/quantized-lite-canary.yaml
kubectl rollout status deploy/quantized-lite-canary -n inference
```
maya: canary rollout success on 3 pods in rtx-pool, initial validation OK (latency higher but within SLA for fallback).
oncall-sre: updated router to send 15% of /v1/generate traffic to quantized model on rtx-pool. queue_length->720 in eu-central.
ryan-eng: good progress. support-bot, please post an incident notice to status page with affected routes and mitigation in place.
support-bot: posted: "Incident: GPU capacity contention in eu-central impacting /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Mitigation: partial routing to dedicated pools and quantized-model fallback. Next update in 30m." :white_check_mark:
jem: log collection: can someone attach the autoscaler logs and provider error traces to the ticket? we'll need them for RCA.
maya: uploaded cluster-autoscaler.log and provider_error_trace.log to CS-98712 and internal incident folder.
ryan-eng: temporary mitigation summary: 1) route 20% traffic to dedicated-gpu-pool-2, 2) deploy redwood-lite-quantized on rtx-pool and route 15% traffic, 3) rate-limited low-priority customers by 10% to bring queue down. current queue=420, dropped_requests now low (5).
ops-lead: set oncall handoff to night SRE at 22:00 UTC. jem, can you own customer comms for the night shift?
jem: yep will take it. composing message to affected customers now. will include workaround and ETA unknown until cloud quota cleared.
oncall-sre: adding temporary autoscaler override to reduce scale-down aggression so new nodes stay up once provider accepts. config diff:
oncall-sre: ```
cluster-autoscaler:
  scaleDown:
    enabled: false
  expander: least-waste
```
maya: note: the root cause looks like unexpected quota consumption by a secondary project (analytics-batch-jobs) started earlier today. investigating whether those jobs can be throttled or moved.
ryan-eng: ops-lead, can infra throttle or pause analytics-batch-jobs? if yes, that might free GPUs fast.
ops-lead: yes, requesting pause now. reaching out to data-team.
ops-lead: data-team acknowledged, pausing non-critical GPU batch jobs. estimated reclaim=8 GPUs within 6-10 minutes.
maya: reclaim observed. cloud reports freed 7 GPUs, autoscaler began successful provisioning of 4 nodes, new capacity becoming available. queue_length -> 180.
jem: support-bot: updated status: "Mitigation effective: partial routing + quantized fallback + reclaimed batch GPUs. Degraded service still possible, monitoring."
support-bot: customers notified update.
ryan-eng: agree we should prepare postmortem skeleton and list action items. immediate action items I propose:
- increase cloud GPU quota for eu-central (owner: ops-lead)
- enforce quota guardrails to prevent unrelated projects from consuming shared GPU quota (owner: maya)
- add autoscaler telemetry alert for repeated quotaExceeded events (owner: oncall-sre)
- pre-authorized overflow routing to dedicated pools when queue crosses threshold (owner: runtime-team)
- automated fallback to quantized models for non-SLA traffic (owner: product)
jem: adding: update runbook with exact steps we used (router override, deploy quantized model, pause batch jobs) and include Slack commands + payloads. (owner: jem)
ops-lead: I'll open a follow-up ticket to request permanent quota increase and degrowth plan for analytics.
oncall-sre: one more ops note: need to remove the temporary cluster-autoscaler disable-scale-down after we stabilize. flagging for next morning.
maya: thanks all. moving this thread to postmortem channel in ~2h for writeup, but leaving this as the canonical incident thread.
jem: short timeline for the postmortem doc I'll draft: summary, timeline, impact (customers affected & approx 429 rates), root cause (quota exhaustion due to analytics jobs), mitigation steps, action items with owners and due dates. aiming for draft in 6 hours.
ops-lead: thanks team. handing off to night SRE (alex-night) at 22:00 UTC. if anything flares, page oncall-sre and escalate to me. :hand:
alex-night (joined): ack. monitoring dashboards and will escalate if queue > 400 again.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (partial) - queue below threshold, mitigation measures in place. please file postmortem and close ticket when RCAs and actions tracked.
